title: [Cannabidiol inhibits neuronal endoplasmic reticulum stress and apoptosis in rats with multiple concussions by regulating the PERK-eIF2alpha-ATF4-CHOP pathway].
authors: Yang, Yujia; Yang, Lifang; Wu, Yaling; Duan, Zhaoda; Yu, Chunze; Wu, Chunyun; Yu, Jianyun; Yang, Li
journal: Nan fang yi ke da xue xue bao = Journal of Southern Medical University
one_liner_zh: 该文研究大麻二酚通过PERK-eIF2alpha-ATF4-CHOP通路抑制脑震荡大鼠内质网应激与凋亡，核心为小分子-蛋白互作，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，亦无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: To explore the effects of cannabidiol on endoplasmic reticulum stress and neuronal apoptosis in rats with multiple concussions (MCC). METHODS: SD rats were randomized into sham group, MCC group, 1% tween20 (TW) treatment group, and low-dose (10 mg/kg) and high-dose (40 mg/kg) cannabidiol treatment groups. In all but the sham group, MCC models were established using a metal pendulum percussion device, after which the rats received daily intraperitoneal injections of the corresponding agents for 2 weeks. The expressions of PERK, eIF2alpha, ATF4, CHOP, TRIB3, p-Akt and pro-caspase-3 in the brain tissue of the rats were detected with qRT-PCR, Western blotting and immunofluorescence staining. The core targets of cannabidiol in treatment of traumatic brain injury (TBI) were identified by network pharmacology analysis, and molecular docking was carried out to simulate the interaction of cannabidiol with the factors related to endoplasmic reticulum stress and apoptosis. RESULTS: Compared with the sham-operated rats, the rat models of MCC showed significantly increased mRNA expressions of PERK, eIF2alpha and CHOP and protein expressions of PERK, eIF2alpha, ATF4, CHOP, TRIB3, p-AKT and pro-caspase-3 in the cerebral cortex. CBD treatment, especially at the high dose, obviously increased the expression of p-Akt and lowered the expression levels of the other factors tested in the rat models. Network pharmacology analysis indicated interactions of the core targets of CBD with the factors related to endoplasmic reticulum stress and TBI, and molecular docking study showed a high binding energy of CBD with multiple factors pertaining to endoplasmic reticulum stress and apoptosis. CONCLUSIONS: MCC induce endoplasmic reticulum stress and apoptosis in rat brain tissues, for which CBD, especially at a high dose, provides neuroprotective effects by inhibiting endoplasmic reticulum stress and cell apoptosis.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨大麻二酚对多次脑震荡（MCC）大鼠内质网应激和神经元凋亡的影响。方法：将SD大鼠随机分为假手术组、MCC组、1%吐温20（TW）处理组以及低剂量（10 mg/kg）和高剂量（40 mg/kg）大麻二酚处理组。除假手术组外，其余各组采用金属摆锤撞击装置建立MCC模型，随后大鼠每日腹腔注射相应药物，持续2周。通过qRT-PCR、Western blotting和免疫荧光染色检测大鼠脑组织中PERK、eIF2alpha、ATF4、CHOP、TRIB3、p-Akt和pro-caspase-3的表达。通过网络药理学分析鉴定大麻二酚治疗创伤性脑损伤（TBI）的核心靶点，并进行分子对接以模拟大麻二酚与内质网应激和凋亡相关因子的相互作用。结果：与假手术组大鼠相比，MCC模型大鼠大脑皮层中PERK、eIF2alpha和CHOP的mRNA表达以及PERK、eIF2alpha、ATF4、CHOP、TRIB3、p-AKT和pro-caspase-3的蛋白表达显著升高。大麻二酚处理，尤其是高剂量组，明显增加了p-Akt的表达，并降低了模型大鼠中其他检测因子的表达水平。网络药理学分析表明，大麻二酚的核心靶点与内质网应激和TBI相关因子存在相互作用，分子对接研究显示大麻二酚与多个内质网应激和凋亡相关因子具有高结合能。结论：MCC诱导大鼠脑组织内质网应激和凋亡，而大麻二酚（尤其是高剂量）通过抑制内质网应激和细胞凋亡提供神经保护作用。
